question: Load T038.csv (a polystyrene Raman spectrum) and display it as a line graph of Raman shift versus intensity.
answer_text:
I have loaded the polystyrene Raman spectrum from `T038.csv` and plotted it as a line graph of Raman shift ($\text{cm}^{-1}$) versus intensity. 

The data consists of 1,801 points covering a spectral range from $200 \text{ cm}^{-1}$ to $2000 \text{ cm}^{-1}$. The intensities range from approximately $-17.7$ to $997.1$ arbitrary units.

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
